description: Activate when: user says "portfolio review," "cash cow," "Stars and Dogs," "growth-share matrix," "which business should we fund," or "resource allocation across units"; firm has multiple business units competing for shared capital; investor or board discussion needs a visual portfolio health read. Do NOT activate when: firm is a single-product startup with no portfolio to balance; user needs competitive analysis within one market (use Porter's Five Forces or VRIO instead). More: deciqai.com/c/bcg-matrix
